intro: Browse what we have ready for your piercing or jewelry change. Everything here can be fitted at your appointment.
reserveTitle: Want a piece saved for you?
reserveSteps: Take a screenshot of the piece you like.
Send it to us in Instagram direct messages with your appointment date.
We hold it for you until your visit.
footer: Stock changes every day. If a piece sold out after the last update, we'll suggest the closest match.
